claim_ceiling: Three complementary dense embedding modes characterized at minimal sufficient scales for non-jurist-preference views: (1) Citation Heritage — 21yr/137k decisions, center_projected_64dim AUC > 0.75 (superior to TF-IDF citation baseline 0.71-0.74), requires recent years (2019+) for citation pair density; (2) Section Cross-Lingual — 1K sample, Sachverhalt (0.282) and Dispositiv (0.150) PASS thresholds, Erwaegungen (0.094) FAILS; full corpus BLOCKED on section extraction; (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — 19yr/122k decisions, w=0.3-0.4 PASS both adversarial gates but JP remains BELOW TF-IDF baseline (0.78-0.79). Two-mode tradeoff is fundamental: TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (jurist preference, branch clustering); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY (citation heritage view, cross-lingual view, hybrid complement). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Data blockers persist (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026, 174k section extraction). Corpus lane resumption required. No further same-question cycles justified.
evidence_summary: Scale characterization across 8 scales (3yr-165k, up to 158k decisions). Citation heritage validated at 21/22/24yr with 100-730 positive pairs; center_projected AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74. Section cross-lingual at 1K sample: Sachverhalt 0.282 (PASS >0.2), Dispositiv 0.150 (PASS >0.1), Erwaegungen 0.094 (FAIL <0.1). Linear hybrid weight sweep at 22yr: optimal w=0.3-0.4 PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+, but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. Independent rerun v14 (seed=137) confirms v13 (seed=42) linear_citation_concat success rule PASS (mean_delta=0.0392, paired_delta_std=0.0212). Formal suite at 165k: center_projected FAILS jurist gate (JP 0.39-0.42), cross-lang recall 0.10-0.11. Holdout validation v8: true OOS JP ceiling ~0.53. All raw data preserved; negative results documented as evidence; data blockers explicitly acknowledged.
